I have a question if anyone is an expert with hosting a physical node. How do you protect your IP or physical address from leaking? Wouldn’t using a vpn harm your connection?

Your main concern would be if a threat actor compromises your node and has access to your entire network. You will need to segregate your network by using a switch and setting up a VLAN. The node gets its own VLAN and configure it so that it doesn't have access to communicate with any other devices on your home network.
